grammar.summary: 本课学习过去进行时场景与 make 搭配的抽象名词用法。

points.title: 过去进行时与一般过去时叙事
points.explanation: Last week at a dinner party, the hostess asked me to sit next to Mrs. Rumbold. 叙事主线用过去时，场景背景穿插进行时。

points.title: make + 抽象名词
points.explanation: make conversation（攀谈）= 进行该活动，同类还有 make progress / make friends。busy + doing 表「忙于做某事」。

exercises.q: If I were you, I ___ (not be) so confident(自信).
What would you do if you ___ (win) a lot of money?
He would enjoy this if he ___ present.
